note: Frames RECORDED off the running app on a 402x874 pt simulator and normalised to the 393x852 pt reference space, not measured off Reference/*.png. The two are different measurements: an accessibility frame is the union of an element's children and a multi-line label's frame includes its whole line box, so a container reads taller here than the artwork does in a capture. Pixel fidelity against the reference is what Tools/snapshot/compare.sh scores; this spec is the layout regression guard underneath it. Re-recorded for Phase 4i: the card is a fixed-height fixed-slot layout with no translation badge and no Arabic line. Phase 4m re-divides the body between the quote, MEANING and DID YOU KNOW per card, so the quote's height and the MEANING/DID YOU KNOW rows are card 0's (An-Nisa 4:59) rather than every unit's; the card itself, the chip, the title, 'Deep study' and the action row are still identical on all 326.
